title: Malicious code in x3r0day-bunnyhijack-poc (npm)
description: The x3r0day-bunnyhijack-poc npm package is a proof-of-concept malicious package that demonstrates an install-time code execution technique via bin-shim hijacking of a transitive dependency's PATH lookup. During installation with the bun package manager, it executes a benign payload that writes a marker file and opens a browser to a GitHub URL. This mechanism allows attacker-controlled code execution without declared lifecycle scripts or user consent.
